description: THROWAWAY test-only pipe type, never shipped and never merged into pipes.json. midifx/tests/test_codegen.py appends it to the real schema and its params to the frozen wire order, regenerates into a temporary directory and asserts that the new type reaches both the wire tables and the generated editor metadata. It is the proof for the schema-driven UI rule: a pipe type with N params renders N editors with no per-type QML and no app-side table.
